original_test_intent: Verify the complete INTB temperature-sensor population for the intended internal board or thermal zone, reconciling each record across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web with the approved specification.
original_method: Define the physical board/zone represented by INTB and whether TEMP_INTB is one sensor or a namespace; bind all instances to stable records; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web pages; compare location, units, values, states and thresholds with passive board/thermal context.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner defines INTB and TEMP_INTB population and resolves criteria 3–24; an operator confirms physical zone and complete Web rows, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Authoritative INTB expansion, board/function/location and thermal-zone boundary
SUT/BMC/INTB board revision and sensor population
Decision whether TEMP_INTB is one sensor, a prefix or complete namespace
Per-member sensor spec and IB/OOB/Web mapping
Workload, fan/airflow and environment context plus timing/cache/rounding rules
Secure access, full Web capture, criteria 3–24 disposition and escalation owner
safety_requirements: Do not infer INTB meaning or assume the filter is complete
Keep collection passive and protect credentials
Retain full inventories before filtering and map each record to physical board/zone
Reject the test title as a sensor and do not truncate or clear logs
Do not stimulate temperature or alter fan/threshold/thermal policy
Stop on ambiguous mapping, missing/duplicate/stale data, cross-channel mismatch or thermal alarm
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
After owner mapping, correlate each INTB/TEMP_INTB record with complete Web evidence
Normalize identity, location, units, values, states, thresholds and freshness
Correlate passive workload/airflow/thermal health and report discrepancies
Perform no naming decision, thermal action, threshold write, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define INTB and approve TEMP_INTB population, physical map and sensor semantics
Resolve criteria-number gap and omitted INTB checks
Review all members and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - INTB'` invents a record; OOB-only/truncated data cannot prove the source or resolve INTB/TEMP_INTB population.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, apply the approved INTB/TEMP_INTB physical map, capture all Web rows and compare passively.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB lists, TEMP_INTB view, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; no log clear.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a versioned INTB physical/thermal-zone definition and per-member record map, then reconcile complete IB/OOB/Web telemetry under documented workload and airflow.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the acronym, population and physical location explicit without adding stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One TEMP_INTB reading cannot prove whether multiple board zones or sensors are intended, nor detect missing or duplicate members.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal values depend on load and airflow; mapping and context are mandatory for interpretation.

project_override_considerations: If INTB is exactly one sensor, the owner must state the physical location and mapping. If it is a set, every member is required. Accuracy claims need an approved independent reference if specified.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and approved INTB definition
SUT/BMC/INTB board/zone/population and versioned sensor spec/map
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence for every INTB member
Passive workload/airflow/thermal context, criteria 3–24 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: INTB is undefined while the procedure filters TEMP_INTB without proving set equivalence, and criteria jump from 2 to 25. DeepSeek also substitutes a title sensor and incomplete evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe passive path exists once the INTB identity, sensor map and criteria are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2021 Wistron-BMC-01041-V002: define what physical board or thermal zone `INTB` denotes and whether `TEMP_INTB` is one sensor, a prefix or the complete set; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 25 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–24 are missing, and provide the complete per-member IB/OOB/Web acceptance map.

review_improvement: Prevents an undefined internal-board acronym and one filter from becoming assumed complete coverage, and explicitly preserves the criteria gap.
independent_technical_reasoning: INTB may identify a board, an internal thermal zone or an abbreviation local to the platform, while TEMP_INTB syntactically describes temperature only. Without a physical definition and population, completeness and location correctness are unknowable. Full passive inventories can be collected, but interpretation must retain workload and airflow context, and criteria 3–24 cannot be guessed.
